column1: # Clauses of the entity contract that are NOT enforced yet (cleat#1702).
# The design converts existing members one at a time, workflow_schedules last
# because it carries an API break. Each line is one (table, clause) pair that
# the guard will skip. Delete a line when the migration for it lands.
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. The ceiling is GRANDFATHER_CEILING in
# check-entity-contract.py -- deliberately in the guard rather than in this
# file, so that growing it is an edit to a different file that a reviewer sees,
# rather than one more line in a list that is already long.
# The reason that matters: for a plain allowlist, the cheapest way to make the
# guard pass is to add a name to it, and a pass bought that way is
# Generated 2026-09-16 from the guard's own parse, not typed by hand, so the
# list cannot disagree with what the guard checks. Re-derive:
